intent: Design an agentic system framed as a startup company structure — flat, low-bureaucracy — where a founder orchestrator delegates work to IC agents and synthesizes results back into a coherent deliverable that respects user intent.
tldr: Topology chosen (flat startup), Founder agent and stage-report skill written; five IC agents still pending and blackboard now exists as the shared memory substrate.
mental_model: Company-as-harness: a startup org chart maps onto an agentic system where ICs are specialist agents and the orchestrator is the founder.
Blackboard-first memory: a single shared markdown file holds Intent, Spec, Decisions, and Open questions — every agent reads from and appends to it.
Skill vs agent split: rigid, format-stable procedures (like stage reporting) live as project skills; autonomous task workers live as agents.
Human-agent dual rendering: each stage emits HTML (for humans, with a diagram) and JSON (for agents, machine-readable) from a single shared state model, so both sides share one mental model.
Muscle memory by repetition: a fixed four-layer report shape (TL;DR / Mental model / State delta / Open questions) trains the human reader to scan and absorb project state quickly.

state_delta.text: Adopted the flat startup variant of the company-as-harness framing over the corporate multi-layer variant.
Added Marketer as a first-class IC alongside Builder, Designer, Researcher, Critic.
Stage reporting implemented as a project-level skill, not as a founder-scoped skill or a dedicated agent.
Reports emit three synced artifacts (chat Markdown, HTML with Mermaid diagram, JSON twin) from one render pass.
Skill is versioned (v1); shape changes ship as sibling skills to preserve human muscle memory.
Founder will be the highest-traffic agent and can act as planner + router + synthesizer until context saturation is observed.
Founder becomes a context-window bottleneck as parallel IC count or blackboard size grows.
Skill drift if the four-layer report shape is mutated in place instead of versioned; human muscle memory collapses.

open_questions.text: Which IC agent file to write next?
open_questions.default_if_silent: Builder — highest-traffic IC for code-producing projects.
